body.statement: For the glued rule \(\widetilde K(w)=\sum_i\lambda_i(w)q_i(w)\), every mean cell \(C\), anchor \(a(C)\), specified incidence paths, and \([0,R_f]\)-valued action functional \(f\), \[|E_hF_{\widetilde K}^{f}(W)-E_hF_{a(C)}^{f}(W)|\le\sum_e\Gamma_{C,e}^{f}+R_f\omega(h)/2\] uniformly on the declared coverage or separated-risk mean domain, including means centered on seams.
body.justification: The inequality prevents uncharged off-neighborhood and weight-variation errors from invalidating a finite gluing certificate.
body.gap: The polyhedral compactification literature proves that charts meet correctly but has no Gaussian-weighted rule-discrepancy inequality.
body.consumer: An independent verifier can replay every seam and path charge in the primal certificate.
